title: MediaSettings
description:
Personal-edition media capability settings (`cap-image`/`cap-audio`/ `cap-transcription`/`cap-rerank`).

One OpenAI/Voyage-compatible endpoint and key drive all four kinds; each kind has its own optional model id (empty = the capability's default model). Like [`EmbeddingSettings`], this is personal-edition only (C7): enterprise AI must go through the gateway; the generated glue never configures local providers there.

api_key.description: Bearer key shared by the four media kinds (write-only: masked).

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible API root (empty = each kind's provider default).
